knowledge:
- key_parameters: elementLength=A vector of length 2 specifying the minimum and maximum length of the transposon (e.g. c(300, 3500)) ;; tsdLength=The length of the Target Site Duplication (TSD) sequence (e.g. 3) ;; saveFolder=The directory path where VSEARCH clustering or alignment outputs will be saved ;; tirLength=The length of the TIR sequence to consider for consensus clustering (e.g. 25) ;; strand=The strand to search for TIR matches ("+" or "-")
- alternatives: None mentioned, though downstream annotation requires external tools like NCBI BLASTX/BLASTN to distinguish autonomous elements from true pack-TYPE elements.
- when_to_use: When searching a genome for DNA transposons (specifically Pack-TYPE or autonomous elements) characterized by TIRs and TSDs of known lengths.
- pitfalls: Requires the command-line tool VSEARCH to be installed for clustering (packClust) and alignment (packAlign) functions ;; On Windows, the absolute path to the VSEARCH executable must be specified, whereas on macOS/Linux it is automatically detected if in the system PATH ;; packSearch does not discriminate between autonomous (transposase-containing) and pack-TYPE elements, requiring downstream BLAST analysis ;; By default, filterWildcards removes sequences with a proportion of wildcards ("N") above 5% to prevent low-quality sequences from clustering.

workflows.name: pack_type_transposon_discovery_and_analysis
workflows.intent: Search a genome for potential pack-TYPE transposable elements, cluster them, and prepare them for alignment and BLAST analysis.
input: genome_sequence.fasta (The genomic DNA sequence to search)
tir_query.txt (The Terminal Inverted Repeat sequence of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Load genome sequence and define TIR query ;; 2. Run packSearch to identify potential transposable elements ;; 3. Cluster predicted transposons using packClust ;; 4. Read VSEARCH clustering outputs using readUc and readBlast ;; 5. Analyze TIR similarities using tirClust ;; 6. Align clustered elements using packAlign ;; 7. Export candidates to FASTA, CSV, or GRanges formats.
workflows.code:
Biostrings::DNAString("CATG")

Biostrings::DNAStringSet(c(
    "CATG",
    "GTAC"
))

Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(
    system.file("extdata", "packMatches.fasta", package = "packFinder"),
    format = "fasta"
)

data("arabidopsisThalianaRefseq")

packMatches <- packSearch(
    Biostrings::DNAString("CACTACAA"),
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    elementLength = c(300, 3500),
    tsdLength = 3
)

head(packMatches)

data(packMatches)

# packMatches <- packClust(
#     packMatches,
#     arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
#     saveFolder = "tempOutput"
# )

readUc(system.file(
    "extdata",
    "packMatches.uc",
    package = "packFinder"
))

readBlast(system.file(
    "extdata",
    "packMatches.blast6out",
    package = "packFinder"
))

consensusSeqs <- tirClust(packMatches,
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    tirLength = 25
)

head(consensusSeqs)

# packMatches <- packAlign(
#     packMatches,
#     arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
#     saveFolder = "tempOutput"
# )

packsToFasta(
    packMatches,
    "tempOutput/packMatches.fasta",
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq
)

packsToCsv(packMatches, "tempOutput/packMatches.csv")
print(getPacksFromCsv("tempOutput/packMatches.csv"))

packsGRanges <- packsToGRanges(packMatches)
print(packsGRanges)

print(getPacksFromGRanges(packsGRanges))

packsToFasta(
    packMatches,
    "tempOutput/packMatches.fasta",
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq
)

print(getPacksFromFasta("tempOutput/packMatches.fasta"))

workflows.name: step_wise_transposon_search
workflows.intent: Run the individual step-wise functions of the packSearch pipeline to identify TIRs, obtain TSDs, and filter potential elements.
input: genome_sequence.fasta (The genomic DNA sequence to search)
tir_query.txt (The Terminal Inverted Repeat sequence of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify potential forward and reverse TIR matches using identifyTirMatches ;; 2. Obtain TSD sequences using getTsds ;; 3. Filter and identify potential pack elements using identifyPotentialPackElements ;; 4. Retrieve transposon sequences using getPackSeqs.
workflows.code:
forwardMatches <- identifyTirMatches(
    Biostrings::DNAString("CACTACAA"),
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    strand = "+",
    tsdLength = 3
)
nrow(forwardMatches)

reverseMatches <- identifyTirMatches(
    Biostrings::reverseComplement(Biostrings::DNAString("CACTACAA")),
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    strand = "-",
    tsdLength = 3
)
nrow(reverseMatches)

forwardMatches$TSD <- getTsds(
    forwardMatches,
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    3,
    strand = "+"
)

head(forwardMatches)

reverseMatches$TSD <- getTsds(
    reverseMatches,
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    3,
    strand = "-"
)

head(reverseMatches)

identifyPotentialPackElements(
    forwardMatches,
    reverseMatches,
    arabidopsisThalianaRefseq,
    c(300, 3500)
)

getPackSeqs(packMatches, arabidopsisThalianaRefseq)
